QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_22

question.text: Fund has DPI of 0.80 and RVPI of 1.10 at end of year 4. Compute TVPI.

explanation.text: The Logic: TVPI = DPI + RVPI = 0.80 + 1.10 = 1.90x. Equivalently, TVPI = (cumulative distributions + residual value) / paid-in capital. TVPI therefore captures both distributed and unrealised value relative to paid-in capital. The Trap: 0.88 multiplies the two ratios. 1.38 uses an average. 1.10 ignores the DPI contribution. Note: DPI + RVPI = TVPI until the final exit, at which point RVPI typically falls to zero.
